skills._doc: SQL LIKE patterns (over absolute paths) that mark indexed files as skill/prompt candidates for `sb skills import`. Add your own folders, e.g. "%/MyPrompts/%.md".

_vaults_doc: Notes vaults (folders of Markdown notes you edit in Obsidian or any editor), read-only. Each: {path, include_personal, include_clients, folder_map}. folder_map maps a top folder that is not a standard category to one, e.g. {"AI": "knowledge", "copilot": "skip"}. Categories: home inbox daily company services clients projects sales knowledge meetings decisions archive systems personal notes; skipped: templates bases canvas assets skip.
